The '''TH-15A Corpsman''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that was used during both the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. Some Mandalorians continue to still use the armor during the [[war against Zakuul]].
